CHIAROSCURO WEDDINGS — WEBSITE DEMO

Deploy manually:
Extract the ZIP and upload this folder's contents to your static hosting service.
index.html must be at the website root. Keep assets/ alongside it.
No install or build command is required.

Included:
- Supplied Chiaroscuro portfolio photography
- Cinematic photo slideshow with photograph selection and pause controls
- Animated typography and scroll reveals
- Image hover motion, gallery navigation and reading progress
- Responsive layouts and reduced-motion support
- Browser-local enquiry draft builder (does not send or store enquiries)

Google Fonts requires an internet connection; fallback fonts are provided.
Films and contact links open Instagram.
The demo label is intentional. Contact copy and enquiry delivery should be
confirmed before the final client launch.

Validation: JavaScript syntax and local asset references checked.
Browser visual and interaction testing remains unverified because local
preview access was declined earlier in this chat.
